title: LLM Text Generation (MLX) (LLM, ML Model, MLX (Apple Silicon))
cap_description: Generate text using MLX models on Apple Silicon. Output is NDJSON streaming tokens.
documentation:
## Purpose

Runs autoregressive text generation using MLX-optimized models on Apple Silicon. Accepts a fully-structured generation request and streams output as NDJSON tokens. Designed for fast, energy-efficient inference on Mac M-series hardware.

## Inputs

A single JSON generation request record containing: the prompt, model spec (MLX HuggingFace repo or local path), sampling parameters (temperature, top-p, repeat penalty, max tokens, seed), and an optional system prompt.

## Outputs

An NDJSON stream. Each line is a JSON object carrying token text, status events (`started`, `complete`), and a final summary with token counts and timing.

## Notes

- Requires Apple Silicon (M1 or later).
- MLX uses unified memory — models share CPU/GPU memory without copying, giving practical access to large models on machines with ample RAM.
- Every execution is streaming.
- For cross-platform pipelines, use [LLM Text Generation (GGUF)](https://capdag.com/browse/cap:gguf;in="media:llm-generation-request;json;record";llm;ml-model;op=llm_inference;out="media:llm-text-stream;ndjson").

## Model task
The inference modality of a model. Model-task narrows what kind of inference cap a
model spec is suitable for: an LLM cannot serve transcription, a transcription model
cannot serve text generation. The task tag is part of the model-spec URN; it is set
by the cap declaring its model-spec input slot, not derived from the model file.

Causal language model for text generation and instruction following. Accepts a text
prompt and produces a text continuation, typically token-by-token via streaming.

## ML model
Marker indicating the cap invokes a machine-learning model. Inputs typically
include a model spec or model artifact; the cap is subject to model-resolution
and hardware-pressure policies.

The cap invokes a machine-learning model.

## Backend
The inference framework or runtime that loads and executes a model. Backend choice
determines weight format, hardware acceleration, and runtime characteristics. A media
URN that omits the backend tag is backend-agnostic — it accepts any backend.

MLX is Apple's array framework for machine learning, native to Apple Silicon. Models
are stored as safetensors with MLX-specific config. Exploits the unified memory
architecture of M-series chips for fast, energy-efficient inference. Apple Silicon
only.
